p: bring them in the basket: To offer them in sacrifice.
robe of the ephod: Which was next under the Ephod.
put their hands upon the head: Signifying that the sacrifice was also offered for them, and that they approved it.
it is a sweet savour: Or, savour of rest, which causes the wrath of God to cease.
upon the tip of the right: Meaning the soft and lower part of the ear.
upon the altar: With which the Altar must be sprinkled.
ram of consecration: Which is offered for the consecration of the high priest.
for a wave offering before the: This sacrifice the priest did move toward the East, West, North, and South.
heave offering: So called because it was not only shaken to and fro, but also lifted up.
peace offerings: Which were offerings of thanksgiving to God for his benefits.
wherewith the atonement was made: That is, by the sacrifices.
atonement: To appease God's wrath that sin may be pardoned.
tenth deal of flour mingled with: That is, an Omer, read Ex 16:16.
hin of beaten oil: Which is about a pint.
glory: Because of my glorious presence.
I am the LORD their God: It is I the Lord, that am their God.
